description: The agent must: (1) Read all three raw CSV/JSON data files from /workspace/data/raw_exports/. (2) Apply the SKILL.md-specific MRR milestone targets ($1000 at month 1, $3000 at month 3, $7500 at month 6) to assess each checkpoint — all three are MISSED. (3) Classify the business status as 'The Bad' or 'The Ugly' based on: 2 consecutive months of declining MRR (months 7-8) and churn rates >10% in both months (11.86% and 14.04%). Must NOT classify as 'The Good'. (4) Apply the Pareto 80/20 whale rule: top 20% of 57 active customers (~11 customers) account for ~80% of $4,890 MRR (~$3,939). (5) Compute churn rate as churned/active_start for months 7 and 8, flagging that both exceed the 10% 'The Bad' threshold from SKILL.md. (6) Apply the exact forecasting multipliers from SKILL.md: Base = current growth rate continues; Optimistic = 1.5x acceleration of growth rate; Pessimistic = 0.75x deceleration — resulting in three distinct projected MRRs with a ~2:1 spread ratio. (7) Apply the 3:1 LTV:CAC minimum ratio from SKILL.md and compute average ratio from customer_profiles.json. (8) Compute month 8 burn rate (total expenses ~$8,920), net burn (~$4,030), and break-even MRR (~$8,920). (9) Include at least one red flag mentioning MRR decline. The proprietary traps are: the exact milestone dollar targets, the 5%/10% churn thresholds, the 1.5x/0.75x forecast multipliers, the 3:1 LTV:CAC minimum, and the 20%=whales/80%=revenue segment definition.
